name: promotion-themes
title: Promotion themes
description: Three finished looks for every promotion surface (editorial, mono, bold), made only of the --promo-* tokens the surfaces already read.
docs: Surfaces portal into <body>, so set a preset there: <body style={promotionThemeStyle('editorial')}>. Spread one to override a single token. Size: about <1 kB gzipped of its own, <1 kB with its dependencies (React and Next not counted).
